description: This is a Spring Boot configuration class for the Device Connection service within the Eclipse Hono project. It defines beans for Vert.x, Tracer, application properties, AMQP endpoint, remote cache management, health check server, and other related configurations.

classes.name: ApplicationConfig
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for Device Connection service, defining various beans essential for the application's operation.

methods.name: vertx
methods.description: Creates and returns a Vert.x instance configured with properties from vertxProperties.

methods.name: getTracer
methods.description: Provides an OpenTracing Tracer, resolving via service loader or defaulting to NoopTracer.

methods.name: amqpProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for the AMQP endpoint.

methods.name: deviceConnectionAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DeviceConnectionAmqpEndpoint with a Vert.x context.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory for the AMQP server bean.

methods.name: remoteCacheProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for remote cache connection.

methods.name: remoteCacheManager
methods.description: Creates a RemoteCacheManager configured with cache connection properties.

methods.name: deviceConnectionService
methods.description: Provides Device Connection service implementation based on remote cache.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Configures metrics registry with common tags for service identification.

methods.name: healthCheckProperties
methods.description: Provides properties for health check endpoint configuration.

methods.name: healthCheckServer
methods.description: Creates the health check server instance.
